title: Dominic and the Salt
author: Lior Villalobos
blurb: Hazel Zhou, a mercenary sworn to a god that went silent, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. But when the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain before the long winter finishes falling.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
